correctness.rationale: The damped drift is Hurwitz for every g>0, giving the unique bounded stationary solution by convolution with the stationary two-sided chain; sign symmetry gives zero first moments and the stationary q² identity gives E[qp]=0. The signed generator contributes −2ρ, not −ρ. As a check on the proof-critical mixed moment, put B=1+2gρ+4ρ² and let x=L21, y=L12. Eliminating L30 and L03 gives a x−2y=M20 and 2d x+e y=3M02 with a=g+2ρ+3/(2ρ), d=3g+2ρ and e=3+d(2g+2ρ). Their determinant is ae+4d>0. The unweighted fourth-order equations eliminate M13 and M04 to give g(3g²+4)M22=(3+3g²)x+(5g+2ρ)y. Substituting M20=(g+2ρ)/(gB), M02=2ρ/(gB) gives the displayed M22; equivalently, with D3=2ρ(ae+4d) and N as in RESULT.md, NB−(g+2ρ)(3g²+4)D3=−2gP, the exact subtraction needed for the covariance. Strictly positive ∂ρP, ∂gP and the sign of P(g,0) give the unique decreasing threshold. The factorization P(0,ρ)=(12ρ²−1)(4ρ²+9) checks the first endpoint; continuity and monotonicity give the other, both only as limits. The two energy prefactors multiply to a⁴/(4k²).
